rationale: The stock has already dropped ~10% from prior close with price sitting at 4.9% of today's range (near the low), creating conflicting signals — a short risks a mean-reversion bounce while a long risks continuation of the strong downtrend. The 9-EMA ($148.25) is above current price and VWAP ($151.77) is significantly above, both acting as overhead resistance, but with no news catalyst and the last few candles showing choppy, low-conviction price action near the session low, there is insufficient directional edge to justify a new position given the already-stressed daily P&L and limited loss budget remaining.
